status_meaning: Declaration of required behavior only. Neither source inspection nor presence in this catalog proves implementation or wire interoperability.

common_requirements.configuration: Every field needs absent/default, valid non-default, wrong type, range/enum, null, unknown field and conditional-combination checks where applicable.
common_requirements.wire: Expand by applicable protocol, network, security, UDP codec and IPv4/IPv6/domain. One row may require many concrete cases.
common_requirements.peer_policy: Apply matching mode-specific peer overrides; default_peer is not permission to ignore native-only modes. A failed Mihomo case is retained, never re-labelled PASS through a different peer.
common_requirements.unknown_modes: required-but-peer-unproven; BLOCKED until proven. Do not drop the target or silently replace the codec.
common_requirements.runtime_dependency: This catalog is repository-local. No script reads an external design document to determine coverage.

peer_override_rules.when: All wire behavior, including shared fields.
peer_override_rules.reason: Mihomo has no WireGuard listener; do not substitute a Mihomo outbound or same-library self-pair.

peer_override_rules.when: ports/hop-interval and every combination with Salamander, bandwidth or shared fields.
peer_override_rules.reason: One native Hysteria QUIC state with a redirected multi-port ingress is required; independent Mihomo services do not share this state.

peer_override_rules.when: Server disableUDP=true; C05/HY2 DATAGRAM negative behavior.
peer_override_rules.reason: Native Hysteria exposes the authenticated server UDP-disabled state; TCP must remain usable.

peer_override_rules.when: network=http; transport and applicable shared fields.
peer_override_rules.reason: Native TCP header.type=http is distinct from a Mihomo HTTP inbound and from legacy H2.

peer_override_rules.when: network=http; transport and applicable shared fields.
peer_override_rules.reason: Use native TCP header.type=http; the Mihomo VLESS listener does not expose this transport.

peer_override_rules.when: network=h2; native network=http with httpSettings, not gRPC or XHTTP.
peer_override_rules.reason: V2Ray retains this native H2 listener; current Xray removed legacy H2.

peer_override_rules.when: Standard WS only; max-early-data>0 and custom early-data header or an explicit empty header for path suffix.
peer_override_rules.reason: V2Ray consumes earlyDataHeaderName and path early data. Default Sec-WebSocket-Protocol cases retain Mihomo. HTTPUpgrade is excluded.

peer_override_rules.when: XHTTP leg explicitly selects only h3; includes every applicable XHTTP/download/reuse field.
peer_override_rules.reason: Use official Xray native H3, not an H3 client or a Mihomo TCP listener; dual legs must share a real handler.
